title: Average annual per-capita water availability
unit: cubic metres per person per year

metadata.collection: CWC Reassessment of Water Availability in India using Space Inputs, 2019
metadata.sourceDetail: Min. of Jal Shakti / CWC; per PIB PRID 1604871 & 2002726
metadata.thresholds: Falkenmark (Min. Jal Shakti): <1700 m3 = water-stressed; <1000 m3 = water-scarce
metadata.note: 2031 is a projection. India crossed below the 1700 m3 stress line between 2001 and 2011.
